title: The Secret Seedling Scheme
intro: Someone has leaked the secret plan for the garden's surprise sunflower maze, and the gardeners are sure a suspect is hiding among them.

suspects.name: Ivy
suspects.line: Sunflowers? I don't know what those look like.

suspects.name: Mabel
suspects.line: I only come for the tomatoes, dear. Nothing else.

suspects.name: Otis
suspects.line: I brought my lunch, so I wasn't really here.

suspects.name: Rufus
suspects.line: I was fixing the fence. Ask the fence.

suspects.name: Priya
suspects.line: I was reading by the pond. The frogs are witnesses.

clues.text: A spilled notebook sat open on the potting bench, its pages still dry. The culprit is not carrying a notebook, so this trail leads elsewhere.
The compost heap was untouched, with no footprints or scattered leaves. The culprit was not last seen at the compost heap.
A scrap of green overalls was snagged on the shed hook, so the culprit must have been wearing green overalls that morning.
Fresh boot prints circled the sunflower bed, and the culprit was last seen standing right there among the stalks.
